patch.value: The gate passes today only because no closed-but-unreleased item exists, so both modes happen to render the same file. That is luck, not correctness: replace mode emits an Unreleased section for closed but unreleased work and prepend mode with --until-release-tag structurally cannot, so the first release following such an item would generate a file and reject it one line later. Found while resolving a reviewer finding on pm-csv about the prepend script surviving the convergence, which is what pointed at pm-brief still calling it from the release path.
The release job generated the changelog in prepend mode and verified it in replace mode on the next line

release.yml ran npm run changelog, which renders prepend mode with a windowed selection, and then ran changelog:check, which renders replace mode over all release tags. The next release carrying closed but unreleased work would have failed its own verification step.
The release workflow generates and verifies the changelog with the same renderer mode, and no script renders a mode the gate rejects
